title: The Extra Plate
hook: Every Thanksgiving, my grandmother set one extra plate. Nobody sat there. This year, we forgot it.
lines: Every Thanksgiving, my grandmother set one extra plate at the end of the table.
Nobody sat there. Nobody asked why. That was the rule.
This year was our first Thanksgiving without her. My aunt called the extra plate silly... and put it away.
We ate. We laughed. For a few hours, it almost felt normal.
Then, just before midnight, the dining room went cold.
Every candle on the table leaned... toward the empty end.
And in the dark, a chair slid out by itself.
Nobody moved. The only sound was a fork... tapping slowly on the bare wood where the plate should have been.
My little cousin started to cry. So I filled a clean plate, and set it down in front of the empty chair.
The tapping stopped. The candles stood straight again.
In the morning, the plate was scraped clean.
And under it was a note, in my grandmother's handwriting.
Next year... set two plates. It's bringing me.
